title: Feature Views will soon be available by default for workspaces with the compliance security profile enabled
body:
Feature Views are now generally available. They will be automatically enabled for workspaces with the [compliance security profile](/aws/en/security/privacy/security-profile) enabled in mid-November 2026.

Define and compute features declaratively from batch or streaming data, then use them for model training and online serving.

See [Feature Views](/aws/en/machine-learning/feature-store/feature-views).
